mapper.select: SELECT md.mbti AS mbti, b.book_idx AS bookIdx, b.book_title AS bookTitle, b.book_author AS bookAuthor, COUNT(r.recommendation_idx) AS recommendationCount FROM recommendation r INNER JOIN member_detail md ON r.member_id = md.member_id INNER JOIN book b ON r.book_idx = b.book_idx WHERE md.mbti = #{mbti} GROUP BY md.mbti, b.book_idx, b.book_title, b.book_author ORDER BY recommendationCount DESC, b.book_idx ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_mbti_ranking ( ranking_date, mbti, book_idx, recommendation_count ) VALUES ( #{rankingDate}, #{mbti}, #{bookIdx}, #{recommendationCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT dmr.ranking_idx AS rankingIdx, dmr.ranking_date AS rankingDate, dmr.mbti AS mbti, dmr.book_idx AS bookIdx, b.book_title AS bookTitle, b.book_author AS bookAuthor, dmr.recommendation_count AS recommendationCount FROM daily_mbti_ranking dmr INNER JOIN book b ON dmr.book_idx = b.book_idx WHERE dmr.ranking_date = CURDATE() LIMIT 1

SELECT b.book_idx AS bookIdx, b.book_title AS bookTitle, b.book_author AS bookAuthor, COUNT(r.recommendation_idx) AS recommendationCount FROM recommendation r INNER JOIN book b ON r.book_idx = b.book_idx GROUP BY b.book_idx, b.book_title, b.book_author ORDER BY recommendationCount DESC, b.book_idx ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT MIN(m.music_idx) AS musicIdx, m.music_title AS musicTitle, m.music_artist AS musicArtist, MAX(m.music_url) AS musicUrl, COUNT(r.recommendation_idx) AS recommendationCount FROM recommendation r INNER JOIN music m ON r.music_idx = m.music_idx GROUP BY m.music_title, m.music_artist ORDER BY recommendationCount DESC, musicIdx ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT b.book_idx AS bookIdx, b.book_title AS bookTitle, b.book_author AS bookAuthor,
MIN(m.music_idx) AS musicIdx, m.music_title AS musicTitle, m.music_artist AS musicArtist, MAX(m.music_url) AS musicUrl,
COUNT(rf.recommend_fb) AS recommendationCount
FROM recommendation r
INNER JOIN recommend_feedback rf ON r.recommendation_idx = rf.recommendation_idx
INNER JOIN book b ON r.book_idx = b.book_idx
INNER JOIN music m ON r.music_idx = m.music_idx
WHERE rf.like_yn = 1
GROUP BY b.book_idx, b.book_title, b.book_author, m.music_title, m.music_artist
ORDER BY recommendationCount DESC, bookIdx ASC, musicIdx ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT r.book_idx AS bookIdx, MIN(r.music_idx) AS musicIdx,
b.book_title AS bookTitle, b.book_author AS bookAuthor,
m.music_title AS musicTitle, m.music_artist AS musicArtist,
COUNT(r.recommendation_idx) AS recommendationCount
FROM recommendation r
INNER JOIN member_detail md ON r.member_id = md.member_id
INNER JOIN book b ON r.book_idx = b.book_idx
INNER JOIN music m ON r.music_idx = m.music_idx
WHERE md.mbti LIKE #{mbti}
GROUP BY r.book_idx, b.book_title, b.book_author, m.music_title, m.music_artist
ORDER BY recommendationCount DESC, r.book_idx ASC LIMIT 10
